end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Used examples including football goalposts, a slide and a flagpole.
Om identified 5 of 6 lines without help.
They noted that all three are straight, with different directions.
Initial uncertainty about slanting lines was partly clarified later.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the three line types through familiar objects and discussed how direction changes while the line remains straight. Om explained standing, sleeping and slanting lines using goalposts, slides and a flagpole; they first mixed up the slanting directions, then identified a slide as a slanting straight line later in the lesson. At home, ask Om to find and name one example of each line type around the house.
